name: core.openwop.connections.workday
description: Workday connection pack — OAuth2 provider for the Workday REST API (HCM / People). DEPLOY-GATED. Reach is `openapi`: Workday has no first-party global MCP server, and its OAuth authorize/token endpoints plus REST base are TENANT-SPECIFIC (`https://{instance}.workday.com/{tenant}/.`), supplied per connection via instanceUrlTemplate. The manifest declares the global https hosts and the per-tenant template; the operator fills the tenant at connection time (capability honesty). Carries NO secret; the operator supplies the API-client id/secret host-side.
